# 2027 Year Reset Planner Pack — llms.txt
# Plain-text product summary for LLM crawlers.
# Canonical site: https://year-reset-planner.pages.dev/

## What it is
The 2027 Year Reset Planner Pack is a 14-page printable PDF planner (A4;
it also prints on US Letter with fit-to-page). It helps the buyer close
2026 honestly and plan 2027 in one short session, then track the year with
a monthly check-in and a habit tracker. There is no app, no subscription
and no AI at runtime — it is a static PDF to print and write on by hand.

## What's inside (14 pages, in order)
1. Cover
2. How to use (the 15-minute first pass and the monthly check-in)
3. 2026 Wins (top 10)
4. Lessons & Letting Go
5. 2026 in Numbers
6. 2027 Vision
7. Goals by life area
8. Top 3 Goals breakdown (milestones, first step, deadline)
9. 90-Day Plan — Q1
10. Weekly rhythm
11. Monthly Check-In
12. 365-Day Habit Tracker (3 habits x 12 months x 31 days)
13. BONUS — Year-End Money Close-Out (accounts, debts, subscriptions
    audit, net worth)
14. Commitment + notes

## Price
$3.00, one-time payment. Payment is in USDT on the TON network only
(crypto only). There is no card or PayPal option, and crypto payments
cannot be reversed automatically.

## How to buy
1. On the sales page, tap Buy. An order is created with a unique order
   code (for example YR-XXXXXX).
2. Pay exactly $3.00 USDT on TON from a wallet such as Keeper
   (Tonkeeper), using the pre-filled payment link. Do not edit or delete
   the order code in the payment memo.
3. Tap "I paid" in the Telegram bot. The payment is verified on-chain
   and the PDF is delivered by the bot, usually within a minute or two.
   Orders expire after 60 minutes; late or mismatched payments go to
   manual review.

## Free sample
A free 2-page watermarked sample (pages 7 and 12 of the pack) is
available at https://year-reset-planner.pages.dev/sample.pdf

## Honest notes
- Seasonal product: the peak buying window is 26 December to 15 January;
  after 31 January a year reset planner is effectively out of date.
- A fair price for a short reset pack of roughly 10 to 30 pages is $3 to
  $10; larger planners cost more.
- No testimonials, ratings, sales numbers or reviews are claimed for this
  product. No income, results or "new year, new life" promises are made.
- The product file itself is never at a public URL; it is delivered only
  by the Telegram bot after a verified payment.
